summary.text: Diego Bernal is a Democratic state representative from Texas who has represented District 123 since 2015 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
He previously served on the San Antonio City Council and has worked as a social worker and attorney.

paragraphs.text: Diego Bernal graduated from Thomas Jefferson High School and earned a B.S., an M.S. in social work and a J.D. from the University of Michigan.
His professional experience includes working as a social worker and as an attorney.
Bernal represented San Antonio City Council District 1 from 2011 to 2014.
He assumed office in the Texas House in 2015, and in 2023 and 2024 he was assigned to the Urban Affairs Committee and the Agriculture and Livestock Committee.
